source.note: No real product. A generic warm-Japandi visual proxy made for the demo catalogue; it copies no retailer's design and carries no brand.
source.generation: Higgsfield multi_image_to_3d from a four-view AI turnaround sheet generated with the Codex image_gen tool (codex-image.sh); should_texture=true, enable_pbr=true, should_remesh=true, topology=triangle, target_polycount=28000, symmetry_mode=auto, rigging and animation off.
source.postProcessing: @gltf-transform/cli resize --width 1024 --height 1024, then scripts/fit_glb.py per-axis fit (centres the footprint, puts the base at y=0).
source.priceProvenance: invented: a plausible demo figure, not a real or quoted price

knownLimitations: No real product. Generic Japandi visual proxy generated from an AI turnaround sheet; the catalogue price is invented, not sourced.
Fit missed and fit_glb.py exited 1, outside the repository's asset-check tolerance: shipped 49.5 x 35.9 x 19.5 cm against the requested 55 x 40 x 14 (5.5 cm narrow, 4.1 cm shallow, 5.5 cm tall).

The footprint proportion is right and the height is not. The raw mesh measured 189.3 x 137.2 x 82.0 cm: a 1.38:1 footprint against the requested 55:40, which is 1.375:1, essentially exact. But it is proportionally about 70 percent taller than the requested 14 cm, so the per-axis fit hit its 10 percent anisotropy cap and shrank the footprint instead of flattening the stack.

The tall stack is faithful to the source sheet rather than to the listing: the sheet showed a chunky multi-fold pile, not a thin folded square. If the catalogue needs a 14 cm throw, the listing height is the thing to change, not this mesh.

Not inspected in a render; no render was available to this agent. The source turnaround sheet showed four views of one neatly folded oatmeal-cream chunky knit throw with a deep, clearly readable garter and rib stitch, soft rounded folded edges down one side, and stacked layers visible in the side view.
PBR textures resized to 1024 px, so the chunky knit stitch is softer than the source sheet.
PLACEMENT: Sits on a bed, sofa or bench, not on open floor.
